name: ZKVerifyPass
description: A platform for private data verification using zk-SNARKs for identity/compliance without revealing info

scripts.setup-circuit: snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 12 pot12_0000.ptau -v && snarkjs powersoftau contribute pot12_0000.ptau pot12_0001.ptau --name="First contribution" -v && snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 pot12_0001.ptau pot12_final.ptau -v && snarkjs groth16 setup verify.r1cs pot12_final.ptau verify_0000.zkey && snarkjs zkey contribute verify_0000.zkey verify_0001.zkey --name="1st Contributor Name" -v && snarkjs zkey export verificationkey verify_0001.zkey verification_key.json
